title: collaborator-ai/collab-public — Collaborator is a place to create with agents.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: GitHub's trending repo with 614 stars is changing how we build software — and it's not just for developers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This tool lets teams collaborate with AI agents in real time, streamlining workflows and speeding up projects.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Collaborator is a platform where humans and AI agents work together on code, design, and more — all in one place.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its unique feature is the ability to assign tasks to AI agents and track their progress in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects developers, designers, and managers by cutting down on repetitive tasks and boosting productivity.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AI isn’t replacing you — it’s making you more efficient and creative than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you tried working with AI agents yet? Let me know in the comments.
